        $this->assertTrue(MachineLearning::trainWithInitialDataSet()->isSuccessful());

    }

        // Test that prediction accuracy is within the expected range after one year
        $this->assertTrue(MachineLearning::predict()->assertEquals(50, 60));
    }

    {
        // Test that no doctor roster creation is allowed
        $this->expectException(AssertionError::class);
        MachineLearning::createDoctorRoster();
    }

    public function testNoSlotValidation()
    {
        // Test that no slot validation is performed
        $this->expectException(AssertionError::class);
        MachineLearning::validateDoctorSlot();
    }

    }

        $this->assertTrue(MachineLearning::processPaymentWithCash()->isSuccessful());
    }
